name: Prusa Nextruder Hotend
description: All-metal hotend integrated into the Prusa Nextruder system, used in MK3.9, MK4, MK4S, XL, and CORE One printers. Features the proprietary Prusa Nozzle format that combines the nozzle and heatbreak into a single hot-swappable unit. The hotend uses a 24V 40W heater cartridge and supports temperatures up to 290C (305C firmware limit). E3D V6 nozzles can be used via an adapter.
features: Integrated heatbreak thermistor for heat creep detection
Load cell integration for bed probing
E3D V6 nozzle compatibility via adapter
